text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: One day, {0} and Yuki are out shopping together.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}とユキが、
一緒に買い物をしている時のことだった──

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text:
Come on, {0}!
Let's go to that store over there next.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}さん、早く早く。
次はあっちのお店だよ。

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text:
We're just getting started. As an ideal specimen of cuteness,
I have a sworn duty to show off as many outfits as possible to
the people of the world.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まだまだ
買うからね。
可愛すぎるボクは、
人々にいろんな姿を見せる使命があるんだ。

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text:
Alas, it's not easy being so beautiful. You're
lucky that all you have to do is carry my bags. If
anything, you should feel honored—
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
可愛すぎるのも大変だよ……
それに比べたら、
{0}さんの荷物持ちなんて、
むしろご褒美で──

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text:
Ahh! Wh-what's with this bright light...
I can't see!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うわっ！　
なに、
この光……
まぶしい！？

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text: Aaaugh!
text_block_list.orig_text: うわぁ～！

text_block_list.text: *fwhoo*...
text_block_list.orig_text: ふぅぅぅぅ……

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text:
Haha! Did I startle you? I wanted to give you a present,
{0}. It's my sweet breath... *fwhoo*...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あはは、
びっくりした？
{0}さんの耳に、
プレゼントだよ。
可愛いボクの、
と・
い・
き♪

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I just couldn't help doing that
after running into you out of the blue.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うふ、
意外な所で
{0}さんを見つけちゃったから、
思わずね。

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text:
You want me to stop? Hehe, I bet you're enjoying it.
Look at you blushing, {0}. How cute.
text_block_list.orig_text:
やめてって？
ふふっ、
うれしいくせに。
{0}さん、照れてるんだ。
可愛い♪

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text:
Hey, since we've found each other,
why don't we go on a special date today?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだ。
せっかくだから、
特別にボクがデートしてあげるよ。

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! You should feel honored
that you can go on a date with me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そう！
このボクとデート出来ることを、
光栄に思ってもいいんだよ。

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text:
Of course it's an honor. You get to have me
all to yourself today, {0}.
All right, let's go.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ううん、
光栄に決まってるよね。
可愛いボクを、
{0}さんが独り占めできるんだから。
さ、
いこっか♪

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text: Yayyy! I bought SO much stuff today!
text_block_list.orig_text:
んーーーっ！
今日は色々買ったなぁ。

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text:
Did you have fun too, {0}?
Not like I have to ask.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}さんも、楽しかった？
まあ、
聞くまでもないと思うけど♪

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text:
Huh? The bags are too heavy? That's too bad.
It's a shame that I'm too adorable to be
carrying my own bags.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……え？　
荷物が重い？
仕方ないさ、
可憐なボクに
荷物持ちは似合わないでしょ？

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text:
I shudder to think what would happen if
a heavy bag hit my leg and gave me a bruise.
text_block_list.orig_text:
万が一
荷物が足にぶつかって
打ち身なんか出来たらと思うと……

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text:
The thought keeps me up at night, and I only
get around eight hours of sleep as a result.
text_block_list.orig_text:
恐ろしくて、
夜も8時間程度しか眠れないよ。

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text: That's true. I'm really diligent about it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだね、
気をつけているもの。

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text:
It would be a disgrace to our country —
no, to all of humanity—if I ever woke up
with bags under my eyes.
text_block_list.orig_text:
可愛いボクの目の下に
クマなんて出来たら、
国の損失……
いいや、
人類の危機だからね。

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure you want to ditch me?
If you leave me to walk around all by myself,
I'm gonna get hit on left and right.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいの？　
そんなこと言って。
こんな街中でボクが一人になったら、
すぐナンパされちゃうんだから！

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text: Hi there! You're really cute!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねぇ、
キミ！
かわいいね！

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
We work for a magazine called \"Cutie Culture\".
Do you have a minute to talk?
text_block_list.orig_text:
僕達、
ファッション雑誌
「キューティカル」のものだけど
今、
ちょっといい？

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I thought he was a pickup artist, but he's from Cutie-Cul.
Have you ever heard of that magazine, {0}?
It's the most popular fashion magazine for high school girls.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
ナンパかと思ったら、
取材だったね。
{0}さんは、キューティカル、
知ってる？
女子中高生に
人気NO.1のファッション誌だよ。

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
We're taking quick snaps of
pretty girls we spot around town.
Is it all right if we take a photo of you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
今、
街で見かけたかわいい女の子の
スナップ撮影をしているんだけど、
ぜひ１枚、
撮らせてもらえないかな？

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text: Of course!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もちろん
OKさ！

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text:
My beauty is a gift to all of humanity.
I don't really have the right to refuse sharing it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ボクの美しさは
全人類の共有財産だからね。
ボクにさえ
拒否権はないんだ。

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text: Great, I'm ready for my photo shoot!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さぁ、
早速
撮影を始めようか！

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text: Make sure you capture all of my oozing charm, okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あふれ出るボクの魅力、
余さず写すといいよ。

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text: Awesome. We'll take lots of photos.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃあ、
たくさん撮らせてもらうよ！

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text:
Snap away, photographer. This is your
once-in-a-lifetime chance to photograph me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
どんどん、シャッターを押してよね。
このボクを撮影出来る
千載一遇のチャンスなんだからさ！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Five minutes later...

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
That's it—super job! Not only do you look adorable,
but your poses are great, too!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いい、
いいよキミ！
可愛い上に、
ポーズもいい！

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I'm used to getting my picture taken.
Cute poses are my specialty!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふっ、
撮影には慣れているからね。
可愛いポーズも
お手の物さ。

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text: But let's be real—I can make any pose look perfect. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
もっとも、
ボクはどんなポーズでも可愛いけれどね♪

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Your beauty matches your confidence!
Please, let us take some more shots!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん……
自信にたがわぬ可愛さだよ！
もっとだ、
もっと撮らせてくれ！

text_block_list.name: Passerby 1
text_block_list.text: Look! Isn't that model pretty?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねぇ、
あのモデルの子
すごい可愛いね！

text_block_list.name: Passerby 2
text_block_list.text:
She really is! I wonder if that's her boyfriend
standing next to her?
choice_data_list: I kind of like the sound of that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
本当だ！
あの、
傍に立っているのが彼氏かな？

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text:
{0}? What's with that smug look on your face?
Oh, are you playing the part of my boyfriend?
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}さん？
そのドヤ顔……
もしかして、
彼氏面ってやつかな？

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text:
You, the boyfriend of someone as cute as me?
Actually, that doesn't sound too bad at all.
text_block_list.orig_text:
可愛いボクの彼氏だなんて……
いや、
{0}さんなら、
悪くないかも……

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text: Ha, just kidding. Hehe, did I get your hopes up?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……なんて、
冗談だよ。
ふふっ、
期待しちゃったかな？

text_block_list.name: Passerby 1
text_block_list.text:
What? You're not her boyfriend? Oh, sorry...
I didn't realize you could hear us.
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
彼氏じゃない？
あ、
聞こえたんだ……
ごめんなさい。

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you don't have to correct them, {0}.
You're such a little shy guy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うふ、
否定しなくてもいいのに。
{0}さんは、
照れ屋だね♪

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Ten minutes later...

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text: Incredible! We've never had a model like you before!
text_block_list.orig_text:
すごい！　
こんなモデルは初めてだよ！

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text:
I can do this all day! What about this pose, for your cover?
And then, you could use this pose for a poster.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まだまだ。
このポーズは表紙用！
それから、
ポスター用に
こんなのはどう？

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text: Great poses! Your expressions are perfect, too!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいよ、
そのポーズ！
表情も最高！

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text: I think this pose also brings out my subtle features!
text_block_list.orig_text:
今度は
こんなポーズはどう？
ボクの繊細さが
とても出ていると思うんだ！

text_block_list.name: Passerby 1
text_block_list.text: Omigosh, that girl is SO CUTE!
text_block_list.orig_text:
きゃー！
かわいい！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Three hours later...
text_block_list.orig_text: ──３時間後。

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, what about this pose next?
Maybe I look a bit too glamorous in that one.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふっ、
こんなポーズもあるよ♪
これは美しすぎるかな？

text_block_list.name: Stray Cat
text_block_list.text: Meow.
text_block_list.orig_text: ニャーーー

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text:
I could do this pose, or this one.
To be honest, I really do look good in any pose.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こんなポーズとか、
こういうポーズとか。
ボクって、
どんなポーズも似合ってしまうんだ。

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text:
I'm no longer just a person who happens to be cute.
I have become cuteness itself!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もはや、
ボクが可愛いんじゃない……
可愛いとは、
ボクのことなんだね。

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text:
I feel so bad for the models who will be
in the same magazine issue as me.
Oh, this beauty is such a burden...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ボクと同じ雑誌に掲載される
モデルが可哀想だよ。
ああ、
罪作りな
ボク……

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: How'd it go? Did you like the dream I granted to you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうだった？　
私からのプレゼント！　
いい『夢』見られた？

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
What you just saw was a dream I made for you and Yuki based on
both of your memories. Did it feel nostalgic? I guess you
wouldn't know how that feels, given your condition.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今のはね、
アンタとユキちゃんの『記憶の欠片』を元に
私が作った『夢』なのよ。
なつかしかった？　
まぁ、
まだわかんないか。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you another dream when you've
gathered enough memory fragments.
text_block_list.orig_text:
アンタがもっと『記憶の欠片』を集めたら、
また『夢』を見せてあげるわ。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
To uncover the truths of this world, you'll have to
watch many dreams of the girls you meet... Huh?
text_block_list.orig_text:
世界の真実にたどりつくためにも、
たくさんの女の子との『夢』を見て……
んん？

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
You look like you want to interject that Yuki is a boy.
Don't you get it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
その顔……
ユキちゃんは男の子
とでも言いたげね。
わかってないなぁ～

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
The Yuki on the \"other side\", and the Yuki \"here\", are both
male, but also female. That's what makes him so cute, both in
appearance and personality!
text_block_list.orig_text:
『あっち』のユキちゃんも、
『こっち』のユキちゃんも、
男の子だけど、
女の子なの。
だからユキちゃんは、
見た目以上に可愛いんじゃない♪

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text:
You must accept the truth in your heart.
For both Yuki's sake, and for yours.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちゃんと心と向き合いなさい。
自分の心にも、
ユキちゃんの心にも、
ね。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Well then, see you later! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃあ、
またね～♪

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text: Umm... Huh? Where am I?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うーん……？
あれ？　
ここは……？

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah... I was shopping with you, {0}.
Then I fell asleep somehow.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだ……
ボク、
{0}さんと買い物してて……
いつの間にか、
眠っちゃってたんだ。

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text:
What? You were asleep too, {0}?
We both fell asleep together?
Hehe, that's kind of embarrassing.
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
{0}さんも、
今まで寝てたの？
二人して寝ちゃうなんて……
ふふっ、
ちょっと恥ずかしいね？

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text:
But that sure was a fun dream.
We took so many photos that captured my beauty.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
楽しい夢だったな。
ボクの可愛さを、
いくつも写真に収めて……

text_block_list.name: Yuki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I've made up my mind!
I think I know what I'm gonna do now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
決めた！
ボクのやるべきことが
見つかったよ。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Saying this, Yuki smiled in satisfaction, for reasons yet unknown to {0}.
text_block_list.orig_text: ユキは、なぜか満足そうに笑うのだった──
